$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor. inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema, or the page stops showing after a build. Every search task but the Hugging Face one has a word, place, work type or job type, so it reads Workable's feed of every company; an empty search would read only the biggest career pages. The link check uses a jobs.workable.com link that was open on 2026-11-03 (one call to jobs.workable.com). options.memoryMbytes is store.json's default, 1024 MB: on Apify on 2026-11-03 a word search and the empty form each took about 2.5 minutes at 1 GB (runs 6uFK1C6wG1NyXXCyO and 7XF3iMyDlPMqHCzpz), and the whole feed arrived, so the last-24-hours task stays.

tasks.name: remote-jobs-on-workable
tasks.title: Find remote jobs at every company on Workable
tasks.description: Get the newest remote jobs from every company on Workable at once, with the company, every place, job type, posting date and link. Remote is what the company marked on Workable.
tasks.seoTitle: Remote Jobs on Workable, Every Company at Once
tasks.seoDescription: Search every company on Workable for remote jobs at once, newest first, with company, places, job type, posting date and link. No login needed.

tasks.name: new-workable-jobs-us-last-24-hours
tasks.title: Find new Workable jobs in the US from the last 24 hours
tasks.description: Get the newest jobs that companies on Workable listed in the United States in the last day, up to 100, with the company, place, job type and link. Schedule it daily for a fresh feed of US jobs.
tasks.seoTitle: New Workable Jobs in the US, Last 24 Hours
tasks.seoDescription: The newest jobs listed on Workable in the United States in the last day, with company, place, job type and link. Run it daily for a fresh feed.

tasks.name: software-engineer-jobs-workable
tasks.title: Find software engineer jobs at every company on Workable
tasks.description: Search every company on Workable for software engineer jobs at once, newest first, with the company, every place, remote or not, job type, posting date and link.
tasks.seoTitle: Software Engineer Jobs on Workable, Every Company
tasks.seoDescription: The newest software engineer jobs on Workable, with company, places, remote or not and link. One search across every company, no login.

tasks.name: nurse-jobs-usa-workable
tasks.title: Find nurse jobs in the United States on Workable
tasks.description: Get the newest nurse jobs in the United States from every company on Workable at once, with the company, place, job type, posting date and link.
tasks.seoTitle: Nurse Jobs in the US on Workable, Newest First
tasks.seoDescription: Newest nurse jobs in the United States from every company hiring on Workable, with company, place, job type, posting date and link. No login.

tasks.name: sales-jobs-europe-workable
tasks.title: Find sales jobs in Europe on Workable
tasks.description: Get the newest sales and account executive jobs in Europe from every company on Workable, with the company, place, job type and link. Europe reads as its 51 countries.
tasks.seoTitle: Sales Jobs in Europe on Workable
tasks.seoDescription: Sales and account executive jobs in Europe from every company on Workable, newest first, with company, place, job type and link. No login or API key.

tasks.seoDescription: Newest internships from every company hiring on Workable, with company, place, remote or not, posting date and link. One search, no login.

tasks.name: workable-jobs-with-pay-and-descriptions

tasks.description: Get the newest data analyst jobs on Workable with full details: the description, requirements and benefits as text and HTML, pay as numbers with its period when the company shows it, department, job type and country.
tasks.seoTitle: Workable Jobs With Descriptions and Pay When Shown
tasks.seoDescription: Data analyst jobs on Workable with the full description, pay as numbers when shown, department, job type and country. Clean JSON for a job board or AI.

tasks.name: hugging-face-jobs-workable

tasks.seoTitle: Hugging Face Jobs API: Every Open Role
tasks.seoDescription: Every open Hugging Face job, read live from its Workable career page, with place, remote or not, department, job type and link. No login or API key.

tasks.name: check-workable-job-links
tasks.title: Check whether Workable job links are still open
tasks.description: Paste Workable job links from apply.workable.com or jobs.workable.com and each comes back open, closed or not found, with the job's details when it is open. Handy for cleaning dead links out of a job board or a spreadsheet.
tasks.seoTitle: Check if Workable Job Links Are Still Open
tasks.seoDescription: Paste Workable job links and see which are open, closed or gone. Clean dead links out of a job board or a spreadsheet, with no login or API key.
